lineage: L8 fracture/fragmentation benchmark. THE TARGET PHYSICS for Slot 5 (clot fragmentation prediction).

governance_compliance.article_XXIV: Damage CDF from FEBio source (FEDamageCDF.cpp, FEDamageNeoHookean.cpp)
governance_compliance.article_XXXV: Slot 5 born with the loop — L8 IS the invention target
governance_compliance.rule_10: Simulation is decision-relevant (clot fragmentation = invention target)

source_files: FEBioMech/FEDamageCDF.h (CDF base class: Simo, LogNormal, Weibull)
FEBioMech/FEDamageMaterial.h (damage material point: Emax, Etrial, D)
febio_fracture_from_source.fracture_model: Continuum damage mechanics with CDF-based damage evolution. Fracture = D reaching Dmax (=1, fully damaged).

damage_cdf_options.Weibull: D = m_Dmax * (1 - exp(-((Es-ploc)/alpha)^mu))  for Es > ploc  (line 80)

febio_fracture_from_source.fracture_criterion: D >= D_critical → material point is fractured (element removal or stress = 0)
febio_fracture_from_source.fragmentation: When D >= D_critical across a contiguous region, the region detaches → fragment

field_1_geometry.rationale: Simplest geometry that captures damage→fracture transition. Multi-element fragmentation deferred to later benchmark.

field_2_material: damage neo-Hookean (coupled base + Simo CDF, same as L5)

field_4_loading.rationale: Enough strain to drive D from 0 to >D_critical (fracture)

field_5_observable.primary: Damage variable D(lambda_z) — must show D crossing D_critical
field_5_observable.secondary: Stress-strain curve showing fracture (stress drops to ~0 when D > D_critical)
field_5_observable.tertiary: Critical strain at fracture (lambda_z when D first exceeds D_critical)

field_6_analytical.formula: D(lambda_z) = cdf(Es) where Es = sqrt(2*|SEF(lambda_z)|), SEF from coupled neo-Hookean
field_6_analytical.approach: Same as L5 analytical (already validated in Round 100), extended to higher strains where D > 0.9

field_8_convergence.sfepy: Newton eps_a=1e-10 with damage term from L5

field_9_state_vars: Emax, Etrial, D (same as L5, extended to fracture regime)

connection_to_invention.invention_hypothesis: A measurable signal (stress, damage rate, or acoustic emission) can predict fragmentation ≥1s before it occurs
connection_to_invention.l8_role: L8 provides the fracture physics. The AI loop (Round 104) will use L8 to search for the pre-fragmentation signal.
connection_to_invention.path_to_invention: L8 validated → AI loop on L8 → find pre-fragmentation signal → INVENTION (Article XXXV)

key_advantage: L8 builds directly on L5 (damage neo-Hookean, already validated to 0.0004%). The ONLY extension is: (1) higher strains to reach fracture, (2) D_critical threshold for fragmentation onset, (3) post-fracture stress behavior. The SfePy term from L5 (dw_tl_damage_neohookean) already tracks D — just needs to run to higher strains.
